review_text: The biryani was absolutely amazing! Best I've had in years. The aroma was perfect and the spices were well-balanced.
Service was extremely slow. Waited 45 minutes for our food and no one even apologised. Very disappointing.
Food super ah irundhuchu, but delivery romba late aagudhu. Taste la problem illai.
Portion size romba kuvaiyaa irundhuchu. Money worth illai. Next time try pannamatein.
The staff were very friendly and welcoming. Made us feel right at home. Food was good too!
Dosa was crispy and the chutney was fresh. Sambhar could have been hotter. Overall a pleasant experience.
Packaging was terrible. Everything was spilled inside the bag. The food itself was tasty though.
Place was dirty. Tables not cleaned, floor was sticky. Cannot recommend until they fix hygiene issues.
Romba nalla saapadu! Staff also super friendly. Will definitely come back with family.
Waiting time was too long. Almost 1 hour wait on a weekday. Not acceptable.
The filter coffee is hands down the best in the city. Perfectly brewed every single time.
Price is too high for the portion given. Other places give more for the same price.
Taste la superb, ana price konjam jaasthi. Worth it ah nu theriyala.
Very clean restaurant. Nice ambiance and good lighting. Food quality was also excellent.
Delivery guy was rude and the food arrived cold. Not a good experience at all.
The chicken curry was a bit too spicy for my taste but flavour was amazing. Good overall.
Staff behaviour pathi sollatey. Romba rude ah pesuvanga. Food ok thaan.
Amazing place! Every dish we tried was excellent. The mutton biryani is a must-try.
Delivery late aagudhu always. Food quality ok but delivery service improve pannanum.
The restaurant was packed but service was still quick. Impressed with the efficiency.
Paneer dishes were bland and tasteless. Expected much better for the price they charge.
Good food, good service, reasonable price. A solid neighbourhood restaurant.
The desserts here are incredible. Gulab jamun was soft and perfectly sweet. Will visit again.
AC not working properly. Very uncomfortable to sit inside. Fix it please.
Saapadu super, ambiance super, but parking illai. Ithukku solution vendum.
Ordered through app. Food arrived on time, well packed, and tasted fresh. Happy customer!
The idli was rock hard. Clearly not fresh. Very disappointing breakfast experience.
Friendly staff, clean place, tasty food at a fair price. What more can you ask for?
Medium spice option was actually very spicy. They need to calibrate their spice levels.
Best chole bhature I have had outside Delhi. Absolutely authentic taste. Highly recommended.
